submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on the token that completes a frequent local bigram or trigram collocation (ORDER BY, O(n, import numpy as, greater than, seek re-, are all), with peak strength graded by how frozen the collocation is: breaking the first half collapses the peak while the peak token alone elsewhere fires weakly. Outside these frozen completions it fires weakly and diffusely on ordinary predictable words with no shared syntactic or semantic feature: token identity explains 80% of variance and both vocabulary lenses are near-Gaussian (kurtosis 3.2, 20% agreement), so the crisp claim covers only the collocation-completion peaks.
